context.combat: Actual engagement state supplied by app
context.boss: Actual engaged living boss; reuses combat score
context.areaKind: Accepted for app contract; current music is shared across areas
context.areaId: Reset encounter eligibility on an actual area identity change
context.interrupted: Loading, death and title reset encounter eligibility; mute/background do not count as a musical ending
context.settled: True only after the existing engagement is removed; avoids resolving while retreat settlement is pending

playback.areaRebuild: controller source nodes persist outside scene rebuild
playback.resume: Cocos play resumes PAUSED; already PLAYING sources are never passed to play again
playback.prefetch: Combat begins loading after exploration; aftermath begins loading after combat. Missing aftermath falls back to exploration.
playback.loadFailure: explicit toggle retries; a successfully loaded companion track can continue
playback.assetOwnership: successful load addRef, dispose detaches clip/stops source/decRef exactly once
playback.phaseAlignment: Approximate normalized position alignment only for exploration/combat loop switches. The one-shot aftermath starts from zero and returns to the opening D-minor exploration theme.
playback.returnToPausedTrack: Re-align the incoming previously paused other track to the currently playing outgoing track once; do not reuse its stale earlier harmonic position.
playback.sameTrackResume: No seek on mute/background pause and resume of the same active track.
playback.unknownDuration: Continue outgoing track until incoming duration is known; do not queue a seek clamped to zero.
playback.phaseSeekFrequency: One setter call per actual mode transition, never a per-frame seek.
playback.inspect: active/available/pendingMode, transitionCount, phaseSeekCount and copied lastTransition record with from/to/outgoingTime/durations/targetTime/request reason.
playback.aftermath: A 15-second one-shot, no loop, starts from zero after qualified combat has been peaceful at least four seconds and the gameplay engagement is settled. Its last 1.5 seconds crossfade into exploration at the theme opening. Re-engagement interrupts it immediately.
playback.reset: Area change, loading, title, death or training reset disarms aftermath; it is a quiet release, not a kill/reward claim.

platform: Only Cocos AudioSource plus existing GameResources and PlatformStorage-backed store; no browser audio APIs or direct tap calls

engineEvidence.source: Cocos3.8.8 cocos/audio/audio-source.ts: currentTime setter lines480–489, _syncStates lines454–469, duration getter lines508–509; AudioClip.getDuration.
engineEvidence.semantics: play() restarts when PLAYING and resumes when PAUSED. currentTime clamps using clip duration; if the AudioPlayer is not loaded yet, SEEK is cached in _operationsBeforeLoading and processed before a subsequently queued PLAY.
engineEvidence.endedEvent: Installed Cocos 3.8.8 audio-source.ts EventType.ENDED is emitted on the AudioSource node by its AudioPlayer end listener; subscribed for the non-looping fallback and detached at dispose.

Two premixes share a 32-bar harmonic grid. One-time approximate currentTime positioning prevents arbitrary stale-phase crossfades, but seek latency and subsequent drift are platform-dependent; perfect phase or seamless playback is not claimed.
MP3 Media Foundation decode includes approximately 40ms extra samples; platform loop gap and system interruption behavior require actual TapTap/device audition.
Title/menus use caller-supplied quiet mode; the app still gates authentication and user-input unlocking.
historicalAssets: Original dawn-embers MP3 and lossless source master retained.
